title: Delta's Riyadh Gamble Gets Scarier, Southwest Eyes Widebodies, and American Goes All In on Starlink
summary: Delta's Riyadh launch is two weeks away, missiles are still hitting the airport, and the CEO is telling reporters "safety will make the call" while warning employees not to go. Plus, Southwest might actually buy widebody jets for the first time ever, American confirms Starlink is coming to literally every mainline plane, and United's weird new economy seat finally gets a price tag.
